name: fishball-instance
description: The built-in Fishball instance: runs Fishball in its own private DSH profile attached to the main DSH, and binds to fishball-connector through its contract.
//peerDependencies: Host packages are resolved from the running DSH installation (verified in spike S8). '*' because engines.dsh is the real compatibility gate. fishball-connector is the connector this instance binds to: only its ./contract export is imported (design §0.2); ^1 is its contract major.

dsh.//client: The instance's Plugins card in the main DSH (design §0.2, §0.7): the instance's status, Retry and its one field, `enabled`. The injected packages are the client halves whose services the card uses: locale, the settings form (configForms) and the Plugins page slots.
